name: Washlet toilet
summary: A vitreous china WC with a heated seat, a warm-water spray nozzle and a control panel. The ceramic is plain and smooth, and the technology lives in the seat and the cistern.

philosophy.core_thesis: A toilet is a clean machine for the body, so the ceramic stays smooth and the seat adds water, heat and control.
design_principles: Cast a smooth bowl with no rim shelf, so that dirt cannot stay under the edge.
Glaze the bowl with a hard, dense glaze that has a surface roughness below 0.1 micrometre.
Fit a seat that is heated to about 36 °C, with a lid that closes slowly.
Hide the nozzle in a cover and wash it with water before and after each use.
Place the control panel on the side or on a wall remote, with 4 to 8 simple icons.
Use a tornado flush of 4 to 5 litres, so that the bowl cleans with little water.
Keep the form compact, 650 to 700 mm long, with one body and one colour.
anti_patterns: A bowl with a hidden rim shelf that holds dirt
A seat with a loud pattern or a coloured plastic
A thick, rough glaze that marks
A bowl with a cord that hangs on the floor
An ornate lid with a moulded relief

form.shape: A one-piece or two-piece WC with a smooth, long bowl, a slim cistern and an electronic seat on top.
form.profile: A rounded, elongated bowl with a continuous, smooth outer skin that sweeps into the base.
form.foot_and_rim: A closed, rimless or hidden rim, a broad base with a hidden trap and a seat hinge in the back.
form.proportion: Bowl 650 to 700 mm long and 360 to 400 mm wide; wall 8 to 12 mm; seat height 400 to 430 mm.
rules: Keep every face of the bowl smooth, with a radius over 20 mm at the edges.
Hide the cords and the pipes in the base.
Choose white or ivory for the glaze, so that dirt shows and is cleaned.
Put the electronics in the seat, so that the ceramic stays pure.

bodies.rule: Use a dense white vitreous body with almost no water absorption. The seat and the nozzle are plastic and stainless steel, not ceramic.

methods: fettling of the trap by robot
forming.joins: The bowl and the cistern are separate casts joined with seals and bolts; the electronic seat is fixed with two bolts and a plug.
forming.details: A smooth foot with no visible bolt, a hidden trap, and a small, flat plate for the water inlet.

glaze.pattern: No pattern. White or ivory covers the whole piece, and the controls carry the only marks.
glaze.gloss: High gloss, about 90 to 100 GU, with a very smooth, dense surface.
glaze.wear: Little wear: the hard glaze keeps its gloss, and the seat and nozzle are the parts that age.

palette.strategy: White and ivory ceramic with a pale grey plastic seat and a small panel of soft light.

firing.kiln: A gas roller-hearth or tunnel kiln with a controlled, steady cycle.
processes: test the flush and the leak
firing.scale: An automated plant that makes thousands of bowls each day.
firing.signs: A clean glaze with no pinholes, a flat ground foot, and a serial number printed under the cistern.

pieces.form: One-piece elongated bowl with a heated seat and a slim cistern
Compact bowl with a hidden trap and a side control panel
Slim cistern with a hidden flush button on the top
Hand basin on a counter with a smooth, single bowl

positive: heated seat with a slim control panel

canonical_works.work: Washlet G, first model of the line

emotion.target_response: A quiet comfort: the viewer sees a clean object that does a job with care, and thinks of a calm, bright room.

use_cases: a product brief for a smart toilet
a hotel bathroom render in the Japanese style
a spec for a seat with a warm-water nozzle
avoid_when: the brief wants a period bathroom

modifiers.how: Hang the bowl on the wall, hide the cistern in the wall and shorten the bowl.
Change to a high cistern with a pull chain, add a printed bowl and a moulded rim.

wall_thickness.note: A pressure-cast bowl keeps an even wall of 8 to 12 mm.
